description: This file defines custom placement strategies and related attributes for Orleans grains, including interfaces for grain communication, placement scenario enums, specific placement strategy classes, and custom attributes for those strategies.

classes.name: TestCustomPlacementStrategy
classes.description: A custom implementation of PlacementStrategy with predefined static instances for different scenarios, and methods to initialize and populate properties based on scenario.

classes.name: TestPlacementStrategyAttribute
classes.description: A custom attribute for specifying the placement strategy scenario for grains.

methods.name: TestCustomPlacementStrategy()
methods.description: Default constructor for the custom placement strategy.

methods.name: Initialize(GrainProperties properties)
methods.description: Initializes the placement strategy based on grain properties.

methods.name: PopulateGrainProperties(IServiceProvider services, Type grainClass, GrainType grainType, Dictionary<string, string> properties)
methods.description: Populates the grain properties dictionary with the current scenario.

methods.name: TestPlacementStrategyAttribute(CustomPlacementScenario scenario)
methods.description: Constructor for the attribute, which sets the scenario.

methods.name: GetCustomPlacementStrategy(CustomPlacementScenario scenario)
methods.description: Static method to return a specific placement strategy based on the scenario.
